fields.description: Turns on Onshape reads and CAD reference refresh. Everything is read-only; FoaMES never writes to Onshape.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The Onshape base URL; use the Enterprise tenant URL when the account is on Onshape's enterprise deployment.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The API key's access key, from Onshape's developer portal (dev-portal.onshape.com). Request-signature authentication is used; Basic auth is not supported.
fields.label: Access Key

fields.description: The API key's secret half. Stored encrypted; never logged. Shown only once at creation in Onshape.
fields.label: Secret Key

fields.description: Optional scope limit: one Onshape document id per line. When set, only these documents can be linked or refreshed; leave empty to allow any document the API key can read.
fields.label: Allowed Documents
